title: NOBAD Find engine: events pushed to the UI
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 notifications (no id) the engine sends to a connection that subscribed to them. Each event below is the schema of its params. A UI ignores an event name it doesn't know. Plain-language descriptions: contract/README.md.

status.description: The short status, every 2 s while subscribed.

status_full.description: Everything the Indexing page shows, every 2 s while subscribed. Subscribe only while that page is open.

level.description: The work level, its reason or the pause changed.

activity.description: A new entry in Recent decisions.

download.description: A model download moved on: progress while downloading (up to twice a second), then ready or missing (failed: error says why).

id.description: meaning / photo (download_model, download_photo_model) or a model id (model_download).

notice.description: A sentence to show as a toast. One that nobody heard waits for the first subscriber (the last 5).

show.description: Bring a window up: a hotkey was pressed (text null: keep the search box as it is), or the bar's Alt+Enter (to_main: text is what to put in the search box). The engine already allowed the UIs to take the front. settings / index: open the main window on that page (the tray menu).

here.description: The File Explorer folder the main hotkey was pressed in has been found ("" if none). Comes shortly after show; here_folder gives the same.

quitting.description: The engine is ending (Quit). Exit instead of reconnecting.

models.description: The models result changed (a download moved to another state, a model was chosen, removed or became active). Same object as the models method.
